summary: 6 features and 2 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • application: decouple CLI availability from version detection (be91d88)

HagiCode-org/web

  • session: add idle and last-used highlight to create actions (7a24ebd)
  • ui: animate session card and swimlane transitions with framer-motion (862adc8)
  • project: add one-shot Quick AI commit intent flow (bd7103d)
  • hagitask: extract task icon chooser into dedicated drawer with preview (526797b)
  • conversation: collapse header actions into responsive overflow menu (683ad36)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/web

  • proposal: render create proposal badge with foreground color (ea6ea37)
  • themes: use light foreground for proposal button text in dark themes (e21d229)
